tables.name: store
tables.comment: Daily hours are in store_hours, keyed by store and day of week. A store must have one row for each day, including closed days.

tables.name: products
tables.comment: A product is identified by its UPC/barcode. Store the code as text to preserve leading zeroes.

fields.name: upc
fields.comment: Primary key: product UPC/barcode, stored as text to retain leading zeroes.

fields.name: age_group
fields.comment: Derived from birth_date for demographic analysis

fields.name: sales_channel
fields.comment: in_store or online; online requires customer_id and online_account

fields.name: actual_cost
fields.comment: Derived from accepted shipment item costs

tables.name: shipment
tables.comment: One physical truck delivery. A vendor order can be fulfilled by multiple shipments through shipment_item.order_item_id. Set actual_arrival_at when the truck reaches the store.

fields.name: cargo_value
fields.comment: Derived from shipment item payable amounts

tables.name: shipment_item
tables.comment: One product line on a physical shipment. Record actual quantity_received for every UPC when the truck arrives, including 0 for a missing manifested item. An unexpected UPC may have no order_item_id. Reconcile order quantity against SUM(quantity_received) across all linked shipments.

fields.name: order_item_id
fields.comment: References vendor_order_item.order_item_id when this product was ordered; NULL for an unexpected product. The linked order item UPC must match this row UPC.

fields.name: upc
fields.comment: References products.upc. Identifies the actual product on this shipment line.

fields.name: quantity_shipped
fields.comment: Vendor manifest quantity for this shipment line; use 0 if the product was not on the manifest.

fields.name: quantity_received
fields.comment: Actual count at the store. NULL only before arrival; after shipment.actual_arrival_at is set, enter a count, including 0 if none arrived.

fields.name: quantity_accepted
fields.comment: Count accepted after inspection; cannot exceed quantity_received.

tables.name: store_hours
tables.comment: One row per store per weekday (1=Monday through 7=Sunday). Create all seven rows for each store; closed days have is_closed=1 and NULL times. A closing time earlier than opening time means closing after midnight.

fields.name: is_closed
fields.comment: 1 for a closed day; then both times are NULL.

fields.name: open_time
fields.comment: Required when is_closed=0; local store time.

fields.name: closing_time
fields.comment: Required when is_closed=0; local store time. Earlier than open_time means next day.
